scope: Round 13. SRS.txt 'system - Chatbox with Gemini API - admin side': admin side RAG document management (upload, <10mb limit, >10mb notification, chunking before save to db, header navigation link for admin, soft delete, e2e & unit/integration tests). Builds on round 12.

source_requirements.text: Role description: You're my code-agent, i'm gonna create a sites for system auction, read all Requirements below, then write me a feature-list.json file, with e2e function, unit and intergration tests write to e2e folder. Write changed description (files, changed in code) to docs folder. All delete mean soft delete. system - Chatbox with Gemini API - admin side. description and Priority: for now you handle both be-fe for admin side of chatbox, including RAG documents upload,tonal,business rules, licenses,... Req-1: admin side handle upload RAG, the documents upload with <10mb. Req-2: If documents bigger, send the small notification. Req-3: all documents chunked before save to db. Req-4: put new navigation link into header for admin.

readings_to_confirm: Req-1: backend max file size in be/rag/chat.py is raised from 2 MB to 10 MB (DOC_MAX_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024); Flask MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH adjusted accordingly to accept 10 MB payload.
Req-2: frontend checks file size on file selection / submit; if file >= 10 MB, upload is blocked and a notification is displayed. Backend returns HTTP 413 if a >10 MB payload is received.
Req-3: all uploaded documents are chunked via rag.chunk_text and embedded before saving in the database (KnowledgeDocument / KnowledgeChunk tables in Postgres).
Req-4: admin header navigation in Layout.tsx includes a new link (e.g. 'Chatbot' or 'RAG Knowledge') routing to /admin/rag, guarded by user.role === 'admin' or permission 'user.manage'.
Delete = soft delete (deleted_at set); soft-deleted documents and their chunks are excluded from retrieval and active document lists.
Scope covers documents for tonal guidelines, business rules, and auction licenses.
Tests: Playwright e2e in e2e/adm-006-chatbox-rag.spec.ts, frontend vitest tests, and python unittest in be/rag/.

conventions.tests: Python: be/rag/*_test.py with unittest. Frontend: npm test -w fe. E2E: playwright test e2e/adm-006-chatbox-rag.spec.ts.
conventions.existing_tests: Existing test suites in be, fe, and e2e must pass.
conventions.run_all: ./init.sh or npm run verify must pass before round completion.

features.srs_ref: SRS Req-1: admin side handle upload RAG, the documents upload with <10mb; Req-3: all documents chunked before save to db
features.title: RAG document upload limit raised to 10 MB
features.user_visible_behavior: Admin can upload RAG documents (.txt, .md) up to 10 MB; files exceeding 10 MB are rejected with HTTP 413 and a clear error message.
acceptance: DOC_MAX_BYTES in be/rag/chat.py is 10 * 1024 * 1024 bytes (10 MB).
Flask MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH permits 10 MB file uploads plus multipart overhead.
Error message for files exceeding 10 MB is 'The file is larger than 10 MB'.
Documents <= 10 MB are chunked via chunk_text and embedded before save_document is invoked.
Python unit/integration tests in be/rag/ verify the 10 MB limit and rejection above 10 MB.
evidence: 2026-11-15 be/rag/chat.py DOC_MAX_BYTES raised to 10MB; 413 error message updated; python tests 37/37 OK
